Day 10 (old art) - July 2015 (age 12)

I was really into Skylanders for a few years, which is why I'm surprised this is one of only 2 fanarts of this game I could find

I assume I drew Chill because she's humanoid, even tho I was way more into the dragon characters like Cynder, Sunburn, Drobot, Camo, Zap, Flashwing, etc

wow I had no idea I still remember that many Skylander names

I swear this game had me in a chokehold

maybe I should replay it and post it on YouTube?
